analysis:
Examined the TB-002 provider WebSocket lifecycle changes.

Connection setup: CoordinatorClient+Connection.swift:55-89 extracts connectionParameters(for:) as a pure refactor. TLS still selects NWParameters.tls for wss/https (line 61), and the WebSocket options are unchanged. No trust-evaluation override was added, so the TLS posture is unchanged.

Handshake deadline: connectAndRun (lines 141-149) now calls CoordinatorConnectionHandshake.start. CoordinatorConnectionHandshake.swift:20-47 adds a 30s default deadline (line 14; configurable via CoordinatorClientTypes.swift:204/224). Resolution is single-shot through a lock-guarded PendingHandshake (lines 70-84). On timeout it clears the handler and cancels the connection, and the error feeds the existing backoff loop. The persistent failure handler is installed inside onReady on connectionQueue before resume, so no state gap appears. .waiting is mapped to terminal (line 57). This is an availability improvement against a stalled-handshake peer (ADV-003 network position, A-018). Registration, the attestation/App Attest resume nonce (line 102-103) and the defer teardown of sessionRegistered and the resume nonce (lines 109-132) remain on the same paths, so this adds no new authentication or attestation surface (TB-011/T-053 unchanged).

New error case: handshakeTimeout's description is non-sensitive.

Drain lifecycle: ProviderLoop+Lifecycle.swift:103-119 now treats drain as settled when the client has no registered connection. The rationale is that a disconnect already cancels accepted work and outbound messages are not replayed. The outcome still requires nativeOwnersDrained and lifecycleRemaining==0, so no accepted plaintext work (A-001) is dropped beyond pre-existing disconnect semantics.

Unverified contracts for integration:
- hasRegisteredConnection is not shown. It presumably reads sessionRegistered, which is set true only after sendRegistration (line 159) and cleared in the defer. A reconnect that registers right after this check would leave the coordinator briefly routing to a provider that then reports drained. Draining-state refusal of new work, outside the supplied evidence, should cover this.
- Whether `.waiting` was already terminal in the base is unknown; this is availability-only.

No security regression was identified.
